name: Qwen AI Chatbot
description: Qwen3.5-4B CPU chat; remote image and video

paragraphs: Text chat runs locally on Hugging Face CPU Basic (2 vCPU, 16 GB RAM). The default model is Huihui-Qwen3.5-4B-abliterated Q4KM, a 2.71 GB GGUF. It replaces the previous 10.2 GB Qwen3.8-27B IQ2M model to reduce response latency. This is a different, smaller model, so its answers and refusal behaviour will differ. It still runs on CPU; replies may remain slower than GPU-hosted chat. The app logs prompt size, time to first token, total time, and reply token count for live speed checks.

The app memory maps the model and serves one generation at a time. The default context is 4,096 tokens including history and reply. Long histories or text attachments may need shortening. Max new tokens = 0 uses the space left in that context.
